items.title_zh: 男女将自己绑在一起一年但不准触摸，结果令人震惊
items.title_en: Man and woman who tied themselves together for a year but were not allowed to touch revealed staggering findings
items.summary_zh: 一对在一起了一整年的男人和女人公开了他们在这次奇怪的合作中发现的事情。画家兼行为艺术家谢德庆 (Tehching Hsieh) 和行为艺术家琳达·蒙塔诺 (Linda Montano) 用一根 8 英尺长的绳子绑在腰间，将自己绑在一起，但在整个 12 个月内不允许彼此接触。这次名为“绳子”的艺术合作的目的是探索自由、隐私、控制和控制等问题。
items.summary_en: A man and woman who were tied together for a whole year have opened up about what they discovered during the bizarre collaboration. Tehching Hsieh, a painter and performance artist, and Linda Montano, also a performance artist, bound themselves together with an eight-foot rope tied at their waists, but were not allowed to touch one another for the entire 12 months. The aim of the art collaboration, titled Rope Piece, was to explore issues like freedom, privacy, control, and commitment, as well as the way humans…

items.title_zh: 20世纪50年代，医生使用活青蛙进行妊娠测试，结果确实可靠
items.title_en: Doctors used live frogs as pregnancy tests in the 1950s and the results were actually reliable
items.summary_zh: 历史上有一个非常奇怪的传统，人们用青蛙来正确识别病人是否怀孕——而且它以最奇怪的方式起作用。科学是令人惊奇的，青蛙身体的工作方式也同样很酷。这些粘糊糊的小生物不仅仅是家庭宠物和捕蝇器，它们还是大自然的怀孕探测器。据史密森尼杂志报道，女性在传统妊娠测试出现之前就进行了“霍格本测试”
items.summary_en: There was a very strange tradition back in history where people used frogs to correctly identify if a patient was pregnant – and it worked in the weirdest way. Science is amazing, and the way that the bodies of frogs work is equally as cool. The slimy little creatures are more than just household pets and fly catchers – they're nature's pregnancy detectors, too. According to Smithsonian Magazine , women conducted the ‘Hogben test’ before traditional pregnancy tests were created in the 1970s.

items.title_zh: 令人震惊的美军镜头中发现三架编队飞行的“球体”不明飞行物
items.title_en: Three 'orb' UFOs flying in formation caught in shocking US military footage
items.summary_zh: 奇怪的镜头似乎显示天空中的三道奇怪的光保持着一致的“队形”。这段视频由美国战争部（前国防部）发布，视频中可以看到灯光在波斯湾上空移动。尽管刚刚发布，但该片段最初拍摄于2012年8月23日，由美国空军操作的MQ-9 Reaper无人机拍摄。当地时间下午 6 点刚过，无人机拍摄了这段长达一分钟的视频，
items.summary_en: Bizarre footage appears to show three strange lights in the sky maintaining a consistent 'formation'. The video was released by the US Department of War, formerly the Department of Defence, and sees the lights moving over the Persian Gulf. Although it has only just been released, the footage was originally taken back on August 23, 2012, and was shot by an MQ-9 Reaper drone operated by the US Air Force. The drone captured the minute-long video just after 6pm local time, while using infrared sensors.

items.title_zh: 继“阴茎门”争议后，奥运会滑雪官员将引入奇怪的微芯片规则
items.title_en: Olympic skiing officials to introduce bizarre microchipping rule following 'penis-gate' controversy

items.summary_en: Ahead of the opening ceremony of the Winter Olympics, officials of the prestigious sporting event have introduced a surprising new microchipping rule that's bizarre to say the least. While the big event to kick start the Milano Cortina games is being held at the San Siro on Friday (February 6), the competition itself actually got underway on Wednesday (February 4).
